no-templates-body: Templates appear here when an installed plugin offers them.
no-installations-body: Install a template to see what it created here.
install-note: Automations are created as drafts. You switch each one on yourself.
no-agents: There is no AI agent yet. Create one with its connection first; the template's agent uses the same connection.
automations-gone: The automations this installation created were removed.
activate-note: Open each automation and switch it on in the builder, where it is checked before going live.
remove-confirm: Remove "{{name}}" with the automations and everything it created? Anything already holding data stays. This can't be undone.
remove-hint: Removing takes away its automations and what it created, except anything already holding data.
install-note-segment: Segments are created ready to use and stay when you remove the installation.
already-installed_other: This template is already installed {{count}} times
already-installed-body_one: Its {{count}} automation is still here ({{active}} on). Installing again creates another copy alongside it.
already-installed-body_other: Its {{count}} automations are still here ({{active}} on). Installing again creates another copy alongside them.
already-installed-segment-body: Installing again creates another set of the same segments.
reinstall-confirm_one: This template is already installed and its {{automations}} automation(s) are still here. Install another copy anyway?
reinstall-confirm_other: This template is already installed {{count}} times and its {{automations}} automation(s) are still here. Install another copy anyway?
reinstall-confirm-segment_one: This template is already installed. Installing again creates the same segments a second time. Continue?
reinstall-confirm-segment_other: This template is already installed {{count}} times. Installing again creates the same segments once more. Continue?
